description: Bring a personalized glow to your cabin with the EV Works Performance Ambient Lighting Kit for Tesla Model 3 and Model Y. This 10-in-1 RGB LED setup lights the dashboard, all four doors and center console, with four additional footwell lights for a coordinated interior look.

The six lighting strips include one 140 cm strip, four 75 cm strips and one 35 cm strip. The kit also includes four footwell lights, a control unit, connecting wiring and a remote control. Use the compatible mobile app or included remote to choose lighting colors and effects that suit your style.

Installation is simple, non-destructive and fully reversible, with an estimated installation time of 2–3 hours. Test the complete kit before securing the lighting and routing the wiring. Keep cables clear of airbags, pedals, seat tracks and moving parts. Installation service is not included.
